$comment: Lab completion ledger - the ONLY thing that decides a lab's dot. Green = complete, orange = in progress. Every lab is 'pending' until a human flips it to 'complete'; nothing in the build may set it, because 'the page renders' is not the same as 'the component is done'. `to` is the join key with labs.registry.ts - match it exactly, or the lab keeps the default. `highlights` are the one-line features the finished lab proves ('Controlled', 'Uncontrolled', ...); leave the array empty while a component is still being shaped.

components.label: Button
highlights: Seven semantic variants across three sizes
An onPress returning a promise owns its own pending state
Icon-only cannot ship without an aria-label - it is a type error
`to` renders an anchor, never a button inside a link
Hold to confirm: fast 800ms, default 2s, slow 4s
A hold announces itself, and a too-short tap says so on touch

components.label: Date picker
highlights: One to three months by width, the month you are on in the middle
Every month title opens a year list - a year is one press, not twelve
Always clearable once a date is set; there is no prop to forget
Presets out of bounds are disabled, never hidden
The bound is a sentence under the field, not a tooltip on a dead cell
The rail sizes itself to its longest preset

components.label: Date range
highlights: Nothing is written until Apply - a range is two values
Presets reframe the grids around what they just set
Every month title opens a year list; the phone sheet scrolls instead
A range that is exactly a period is called by its name
Touching a day drops the preset, because it is derived and never stored
The form-bound sibling is clearable and reports its own error

components.label: Pressable feedback
highlights: Scale and ripple, together or apart
Inherits the caller's radius, asymmetric included
Ripple from the pointer, centred on keyboard
Reduced motion swaps the movement for a fade

components.label: Route progress
highlights: Renders null; drives the NProgress singleton
No spinner - one indicator per navigation
A navigation faster than the delay never paints a bar

components.label: Skip to content
highlights: The first focusable thing on the page
Invisible until focused, then fully visible
Targets the id the shell puts on <main>
